verb: boss: bite, stomp-pin; then bite and shake, tail whip; then an enraged roar

clips.tail_swipe: Phase 2+: whips its tail across a target behind it
clips.alert: Phase 3: rears and roars; survivors and small creatures nearby stagger
clips.knockdown: crashes onto its belly and heaves itself back up
